title: Vegan Braised Beef Stew
description: A hearty and comforting stew made with plant-based beef alternatives, perfect for a chilly evening.

ingredients.name: Beefless strips
ingredients.notes: such as seitan or textured vegetable protein

instructions: In a large Dutch oven or oven-safe pot, heat 2 tablespoons of oil over medium heat.
Add the onions and cook until they're softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the mushrooms and cook until they're tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the carrots and potatoes, cook for 5 minutes.
Add the beefless strips, vegan Worcestershire sauce, tomato paste, and thyme. Stir to combine.
Pour in the vegan beef broth and bring the mixture to a boil.
Cover the pot and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Braise the stew for 2 1/2 hours, or until the meat is tender.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh thyme if desired.
